body.message: Got it Denis. The 1BR in Nobles Tower is AED 8,000 a month all-inclusive. Our rates are locked for 3 months at a time, so I can confirm this price for your first 3 months. For anything beyond that, the rate depends on the season and we'll need to confirm with the team closer to the time. Let me check what options we have for a full year lock-in and get back to you shortly.
